newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasury adds to list of Cali cartel fronts.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasury adds to list of Cali cartel fronts.

text.p: The Treasury Department on Thursday added 11 Colombia-based businesses and 46 associated individuals to its list of persons it considers to be acting as fronts for the Cali drug cartel.

They will be considered Specially Designated Narcotics Traffickers (SDNTs). With the latest additions, there are 416 businesses and individuals with whom American companies are prohibited from having any financial and business dealings because they are considered to be Cali fronts.
Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control administers the list.

The 11 Colombian companies include a large drugstore chain, four pharmaceutical laboratories, a wholesale purchaser for a grocery store chain, an investment firm, a plastics manufacturer, a construction company and two agricultural firms.

"The 11 newly designated companies are successors to firms previously designated because they were owned or controlled by the Rodriguez Orejuela or Herrera Buitrago families of the Cali cartel," Treasury said.
